- **Decider (C).** Ставит точку в спорах. Правило: остальные **не обязаны соглашаться, но обязаны выполнять** (*disagree and commit*). Если вы правы, тест это покажет, и решение пересмотрят.
- **Timekeeper (B).** Ставит таймер на каждый шаг части 5 и громко объявляет «осталась минута» и «время». Используйте таймер телефона, видимый всем.
- **Facilitator (A).** Ведёт шаги части 5 по этому файлу: читает, что делать дальше, следит, чтобы шаги не пропускали.

## 2.3 Правила

1. **Таймбокс священен.** Таймер прозвенел — шаг закончен. Недоделанное уходит в парковку.
2. **Парковка.** Отдельный список (на доске или в чате). Всё, что «интересно, но не сейчас», записывается туда за 10 секунд, без обсуждения.
3. **Сначала молча, потом вслух.** Генерацию идей и голосование каждый делает сам и молча.
4. **Стендап раз в 2 часа, 5 минут.** Каждый за минуту: что сделал, что делаю, что мешает. Решения на стендапе не обсуждаются, только синхронизация. Если нужно обсуждение — отдельно, после.
5. **Блокер дольше 20 минут — сказать сразу.** «Я 20 минут не могу подключиться к API» нужно сказать вслух, а не «ещё немного разберусь».
6. **Меняешь план — скажи вслух.** «Я выкидываю фичу X, потому что не успеваем» — чтобы никто не строил то, что от неё зависит.

Starter for the EHL Grand Finale (TUM.ai, 10–11 Oct 2026, agentic AI):
FastAPI backend + OpenAI Agents SDK agent with example tools + a minimal chat UI.

```bash
mkdir -p ~/Developer && cd ~/Developer
git clone https://github.com/ksiox1337/ehl-finale-template.git
```

Without `make`:

```bash
python3 -m venv backend/.venv
backend/.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env   # add your key
cd backend && .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
```

Test from the terminal:

```bash
curl -s localhost:8000/api/chat -H 'content-type: application/json' \
```

Errors from `/api/chat`: **401** = wrong key in `.env`; **429 insufficient_quota** = the

```bash
curl -fsSL https://entire.io/install.sh | bash   # installs to ~/.local/bin
entire version                                   # check it's on PATH
cd ehl-finale-template
```

```
[entire] Pushing 1 checkpoint ref(s) to origin... done
```

Playbook opened, step 3.1 item 6 attempted. Here's the honest result.

## What worked

The agent-made commit + push cycle works:

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Small edit by agent | ✅ marked checklist items in [PLAYBOOK.md:220](PLAYBOOK.md:220) |
| `git commit` | ✅ |
| `git push origin main` | ✅ `7f0e1c3..c6e868e  main -> main` |

One snag on the way: the push was rejected as non-fast-forward — `origin/main` had two commits you don't have locally (`README: warn about iCloud-synced folders`, `Suggest ~/Developer for clones`, probably from another machine). I rebased my commit on top and pushed; no conflicts.

## What did **not** work — item 6's actual check

The push printed **no** `[entire] Pushing 1 checkpoint ref(s) to origin... done` line. Entire is not installed on this machine:

- `entire` is not on `PATH`, and not at `~/.local/bin/entire`, Homebrew, or npm/pnpm global
- `.git/hooks` contains only `.sample` files — no Entire pre-push hook
- no `entire/*` refs exist

---
name: entire-session-attach-recovery
description: Recovering an Entire checkpoint when a coding-agent session started before Entire's hooks could run
metadata:
  type: project
---

In the ehl-finale-template repo, if a Claude Code session began before the
`entire` binary was reachable by its hooks, no session state exists and commits
silently produce no checkpoint. Recover without restarting the session:
`entire session attach <claude-code-session-id>` — it captures the turns so far,
creates a checkpoint, and prints an `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` trailer to put in
the commit message.

**Why:** the hooks in `.claude/settings.json` are guarded by `command -v entire`
and exit 0 when it is missing, so the failure is completely silent — a push just
lacks the `[entire] Pushing ... checkpoint ref(s)` line. Submissions without
Entire are not accepted at the EHL finale (2026-10-10/11), so a silent miss is
expensive.

Also seen and documented in that repo's README: a push can print the `[entire]
... done` line and then still fail with `[remote rejected] main`. Simply running
`git push` again works.
EOF

tail -2 MEMORY.md

content.text:
## Step 3.1, item 6 — verified

```
[entire] Pushing 1 checkpoint ref(s) to origin.... done
```

That's the exact line the playbook asks you to confirm. Item 6 is now checked off in [PLAYBOOK.md:225](PLAYBOOK.md:225) for real, on commit `d03f0b1`.

Verification afterwards:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `git rev-list --count main...origin/main` | `0 0` — in sync |
| `entire checkpoint list` | 2 checkpoints; new one `01M4B3YE…` → `d03f0b1` |
| Entire refs on remote | 2 |
| `entire doctor` | Git hooks OK, no stuck sessions |

## What was actually broken

Two separate problems, neither of which showed an error:

1. **Entire wasn't installed at all.** Item 3 was checked off, but `entire enable` installs git hooks into `.git/hooks`, which is never cloned — it has to be run per clone. Your three terminal commands fixed this.
2. **The hooks couldn't find the binary.** Every hook in [.claude/settings.json](.claude/settings.json) was guarded by `command -v entire; exit 0`. The installer puts the binary in `~/.local/bin`, which isn't on macOS's default PATH, so all 8 hooks no-opped **silently** — no session registered, no checkpoint, no warning. Patched all 8 to prepend `$HOME/.local/bin` (commit `5604f76`). Because that file is committed, Teammates B and C get the fix on clone without touching their `.zshrc`.

Since the patched hooks only load at session start, I used `entire session attach <session-id>` to register this session and get a checkpoint without restarting. I saved that recovery trick to memory — it's silent when it fails, and submissions without Entire aren't accepted.

Also hit the documented flake: the push printed the `[entire]` line and *then* `[remote rejected] main`. A plain retry worked, exactly as [README.md:67](README.md:67) says.

## Still open

**The repo is in `~/Documents/_Personal Vault/Git/`, and iCloud Drive is active on this Mac.** Your own [README.md:12](README.md:12) warns against this because iCloud evicts `.venv` and **git hooks** — the very files Entire just installed. Nothing is evicted right now, but if it happens mid-hackathon the failure is silent again. Moving to `~/Developer` is one command plus re-pointing this session; say go and I'll do it.

One housekeeping note: there are 4 checkbox-flip commits on `main` from this debugging. I reverted item 6 twice rather than leave a false "verified" in a doc your teammates read. If you'd rather see a clean history, I can squash `c6e868e..d03f0b1` into one commit — though it'd need a force-push, so only if nobody has pulled.
